position.name: Behavioral Health Technician
position.description:
Behavioral Health Technician

On-Site | Full-Time | Schedule Tuesday to Saturday 7:00am - 3:30pm | Compensation: This role starts at $17.00/hour during the onboarding and training period. After successful completion of training and certification in core responsibilities, pay increases to $19.00/hour.

About the Role

You are a frontline member of the PRC care team. You support adult clients through structured recovery programming — maintaining safety, accountability, and a therapeutic environment from the moment your shift starts. This role requires calm under pressure, strong documentation habits, and genuine commitment to the people you serve.

Backgrounds that translate well: Behavioral Health Tech · Direct Care · Substance Use Treatment · Residential Support · Crisis Stabilization

What You'll Do

  • Supervise and support adult clients throughout daily programming
  • Conduct regular headcounts, rounds, and safety checks
  • Collect and document urine drug screens in accordance with policy
  • Complete shift notes, room checks, incident reports, and behavior documentation accurately and on time
  • Maintain cleanliness and order of all shared program spaces
  • Enforce program rules with professionalism and respect — firm, never punitive
  • Collaborate with therapists, medical staff, and leadership across shifts
  • Participate in team meetings and shift-change debriefs
  • Escort clients to appointments or activities as needed

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience as a BHT or in a similar direct care role
  • Experience working with adult clients in a substance use treatment setting
  • Strong documentation habits — shift notes, incident reports, and UA logs completed accurately and on time
  • Calm, boundaries, and professional under pressure
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • CPR/First Aid certified or able to obtain upon hire
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Eligible for Level II background screening and drug test
  • Available full-time for Tuesday–Saturday schedule

PRC is an adult behavioral health organization operating PHP and IOP programs across South Florida. We exist to serve clients and families at their most critical moments — and this role supports that mission on the ground every day.

Learn More: Principles Recovery Center

work_history.title: Medication Technician
work_history.company_name: Alba Court Assisted Living New Smyrna FL
work_history.summary: Administer prescribed medications to residents in accordance with physician orders, facility policies, and state regulations. Accurately document medication administration, resident responses, and any medication-related concerns in electronic health records. Monitor residents for adverse reactions, side effects, and changes in condition, promptly reporting concerns to licensed nursing staff. Assist residents with activities of daily living, including grooming, dressing, mobility, and personal hygiene as needed. Perform and document routine vital signs, weight checks, and other health-related observations. Maintain medication carts, storage areas, and medication records to ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Coordinate medication refills with pharmacies and ensure medications are properly stocked and organized. Provide compassionate resident support while promoting dignity, independence, and quality of life.

work_history.title: Behavioral Health Technician
work_history.summary: Performed patient intake and admission procedures, including obtaining required information, completing admission paperwork, recording vital signs, reviewing facility guidelines, and helping patients acclimate to the treatment environment. Administered prescribed medications in accordance with established policies and procedures. Assisted patients with daily routines, personal needs, appointments, meals, and other activities necessary to support treatment participation. Maintained detailed electronic documentation regarding patient progress, behaviors, medication administration, incidents, and significant observations.

work_history.title: Behavioral Health Technician
work_history.summary: Delivered direct patient care, wellness checks, emotional support, and treatment compliance encouragement. Maintained a safe and secure setting by conducting scheduled rounds, patient observations, and safety checks throughout overnight shifts. Maintained documentation and collaborated with clinical teams on treatment plan support. Administered prescribed medications as a Certified Medication Technician in accordance with physician orders, facility protocols, and applicable regulations.
